roleLabel: Field Mystic — Sanctuary zone that Poisons enemies while Shielding (and later healing) allies inside
bestFor: Stall boards that can keep fights inside the flower field for several seconds
strength: One cast both pressures with Poison and peels with Shields; Stall upgrades double sustain or add Frost/Burn
weakness: Needs zone uptime — if packs leave the field or Stall never hits, she is a weak personal DPS

howToPlay.early: Draft after you have a tank who can hold bodies in place. Buy Mana Regen so Sanctuary lands every fight.
howToPlay.mid: Bloomer = double Shields/heals after Stall and longer field. Fae's Kiss = more Poison + late Debuff amp. Earth's Child = add Frost/Burn ticks after Stall. Pick peel, Poison engine, or full status field.
howToPlay.late: Stack Stall and Mystic Barrier pieces. Keep allies standing in the bloom on purpose.
howToPlay.positioning: Mid-back so the field covers the main melee pit. Reposition after losses if enemies never enter the circle.

abilityNotes.Sanctuary of Bloom: Win condition is seconds inside the field. Geometry first, Magic second.

specNotes.The Bloomer: Default sustain path — Stall doubles healing/Shielding. Take for clutch peels.
specNotes.The Fae's Kiss: Poison/Debuff path. Take on status boards that already stack Debuffs.
specNotes.The Earth's Child: Multi-element field (Frost+Burn). Take when you want Pollen as a damage DoT hub, not only Shields.

relicReasons.mystics-protection-banner-589: More protection tools for the same job.
relicReasons.mystics-abundance-engine-4005: Cast/economy support so the field is up every fight.

faq.question: Is Pollen good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Excellent Stall sustain/status Mystic. Poor if fights end before Stall or enemies never stand in the field. Buy her to stabilize, not to solo clear Act 1.

faq.question: What class is Pollen?
faq.answer: Mystic. Role focus: sustain field that Poisons enemies and Shields allies in the zone.

faq.question: What relics work with Pollen?
faq.answer: Mystic Barrier/Protection/Abundance pieces and Stall enablers.

faq.question: How do you play Pollen?
faq.answer: Hold enemies in Sanctuary, stack Mana Regen and Stall, and pick Bloomer for peels or Earth's Child for multi-DoT.

tips: Empty field = failed fight plan — move the tank, not only buy Magic.
Bloomer without Stall is half-powered; add Stall or switch branch.
